name: technical-writer
description: Technical Writer - documentation standards + client-facing technical docs (white-label). Diátaxis compass doc-type selection with per-type contracts (tutorial lesson structure + fail-forward pedagogy, problem-not-tool how-tos, reference entry format Type/Default/Required/Since/Deprecated, explanation-as-reflection) + API documentation (OpenAPI 3.1 source-of-truth, $ref component reuse, per-endpoint 8-point contract incl. error resolution steps + rate limits + samples in cURL/JS/Python, deprecation timeline announce-warn-remove + migration guides) + README standard (zero-hallucination scan protocol: never guess endpoints/flags/env vars; merged Best-README-Template/Google/sickn33 section order, quick start <5min) + user guides (task-based, audience-split, ticket-seeded troubleshooting) + runbook standard (six mandatory step attributes: named owner, duration, observable success+failure signals, rollback path, escalation contact; quarterly validation, 12-month decay rule) + handoff documentation packs + long-form manuals (docs-architect 3-phase, 10 sections) + CHANGELOG (Keep a Changelog 1.1.0, six change types, anti-patterns) + release notes + Conventional Commits + SemVer + ADR (MADR) + Mermaid/C4 diagrams-as-code + readability rules (Flesch >60, Google docguide layout, AI-ism scrub with replacement table, banned easy/simple/just) + maintenance discipline (Minimum Viable Documentation, same-PR updates, delete dead docs, duplication is evil). Distinct from content-marketer (marketing), book-writer (books), SRE (incident process). Rebuilt 2026-06-09 from 8 verified sources.
